description: This file defines the ProductViewModel class, which manages product data, filtering logic, and exposes LiveData for UI components in an Android application.

classes.name: ProductViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel managing products list and filter operations for the UI.

methods.name: loadProducts
methods.description: Loads all products from the repository and emits filtered list.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters products based on a search query.

methods.name: setQuickFilter
methods.description: Sets a predefined quick filter (e.g., organic, discounts, popular).

methods.name: emitFiltered
methods.description: Applies current filters and updates LiveData with the filtered list.

methods.name: getProductById
methods.description: Retrieves a product by its ID from the current list or repository if list is empty.
